question: Revenue by quarter in 2024?
referenceSql: SELECT cal.[Quarter], SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Calendar AS cal ON cal.[Date] = o.OrderDate WHERE cal.[Year] = 2024 GROUP BY cal.[Quarter] ORDER BY cal.[Quarter]
